Breaking ATL News: Trade Deadline
Drama swirls around the ATL as the league's trading deadline looms near. Clubs looking for that one critical piece to the puzzle will be working overtime in these waning hours to pull off that definitive deal. It might be a big deal or barely a blip on the radar, but rest assured, somebody will make a key deal as the clock winds down. Normal trades are allowed again once the playoffs are over and the offseason begins.
